section.title: public interface RecoverableXAResource
section.para:
A RecoverableXAResource service may be provided by a ResourceProvider if they are able to support XA recovery operations.
There are two main sorts of recovery:

listitem.para: Recovery after a remote failure, where the local transaction manager runs throughout
Recovery after a local failure, where the transaction manager replays in-doubt transactions from its log

section.para:
This service is used in both of these cases.
The identifier returned by getId() provides a persistent name that can be used to correlate usage of the resource both before and after failure. This identifier must also be passed to TransactionContext.registerXAResource(XAResource, String) each time the recoverable resource is used.

section.title: public static final String OSGI_RECOVERY_ENABLED = "osgi.recovery.enabled"
section.para: This service property key is used by TransactionControl services and ResourceProvider factories to indicate that they can support transaction recovery.

section.title: public String getId()
section.para: Get the id of this resource. This should be unique, and persist between restarts

section.title: public XAResource getXAResource() throws Exception
section.para:
Get a new, valid XAResource that can be used in recovery
This XAResource will be returned later using the releaseXAResource(XAResource) method

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– If it is not possible to acquire a valid XAResource at the current time, for example if the database is temporarily unavailable.

section.title: public void releaseXAResource(XAResource xaRes)

formalpara.title: xaRes
formalpara.para: An XAResource previously returned by getXAResource()

section.para: Release the XAResource that has been used for recovery
